pin.title: TERRACE & DINING ZERO — Cross Hotel Osaka
pin.description: A third-floor restaurant overlooking Midosuji, with weekend autumn lunches pairing a choice of main or pasta with a buffet.

pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Orix operator announcement confirms the current TERRACE & DINING ZERO identity opens after a full renovation on June 28, 2019. Predecessor GLAMOROUS-X and the later November 2022 refurbishment are distinct history; no hotel founding date or 2026 menu date used.
